edge_cases: No shared private tile cache across tenants or revoked permissions; tile/manifest routes must verify project ACL.
Malformed 3D Tiles archives, path traversal in {uri:path}, or invalid boundingVolume/geometricError trees must be rejected.
Edit-to-tile invalidation and bounded zoom/geometry payloads on 30k/100k/1M feature layers.
Cross-engine convergence across 3D tilesets (E05), map_viewport (E02), MVT /pro/tiles (E08), and raster PNG tiles (E09).

rust_native_operations.status: new in Rust; no FastAPI oracle
rust_native_operations.auth_tenant_scope: session cookie; ProjectRead (project.read, LayerAcl policy) under openvietgis_runtime RLS including restrictive reference_features_gis_acl

response.200: application/vnd.mapbox-vector-tile; layer 'features', extent 4096, buffer 64, property feature_id; empty body when no feature intersects

headers.x-openvietgis-tile-complete: false when more than 10000 features intersect (first 10000 by feature_id COLLATE "C" are encoded)

response.404: foreign organization/project/layer or layer hidden by GIS ACL
response.422: invalid tile address/pins (generic validation envelope); UNSUPPORTED_TRANSFORMATION for non-EPSG:4326 or non-renderable sources
response.503: MAP_READ_UNAVAILABLE {code, detail} on SQL failure or the 2000 ms statement timeout

rust_native_operations.crs: Native EPSG:4326 rows clipped to the tile area and projected with the fixed analytic Web Mercator pipeline (ST_TransformPipeline), never an implicit ST_Transform.
